items.title: Richard Wyands interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 7, 2002
items.q: Art Tatum, well I got to know him, I got to talk to him.

ctx.x: Oh yeah. I figured one of these days I’d get to New York and it would be a good idea to make a good impression. And it worked because when I finally came to New York I looked up some of the musicians that I’d met out there and they helped me get started. But one of the most interesting experiences I ever went through in my life was at the Blackhawk. I’d play opposite Art Tatum, and I was just playing solo piano, I’d play 20 on and he’d play 40. It was 40-20 on those dates, and Art Tatum, well I got to know him, I…
You don’t try to even get close to what he was doing.
